commits.subject: Merge main into Elasticsearch conformance scenarios
Merge main into Elasticsearch conformance scenarios

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Adds Java agent conformance scenarios for Elasticsearch's Low Level REST, Java API, and Transport clients. The scenarios record expected spans and metrics against a digest-pinned Elasticsearch 7.17.29 node.

The Java API Client stays at 7.17.19 because 7.17.20 introduced native OpenTelemetry instrumentation. This keeps the scenario focused on Java agent instrumentation.
metadata.title: Add Java Elasticsearch conformance scenarios
